sources.title: 14.382 Spring 2017 Lecture 1: Least Squares, Adaptive Partialling Out, Simultaneous Inference
sources.supports: Population linear projection, orthogonality and rank; sample normal equations; population/sample partial regression; predictive versus causal interpretation; score-based sandwich representation.
sources.limits: Growing-dimension asymptotics are stated with unspecified regularity and without the full proof. They cannot certify the chapter's theorem assumptions.
sources.transcription_cautions: The p.4 argmin displays omit a square; derive the squared-loss objective independently. The p.3 randomization sentence says independence from X although X includes D: use a properly stated potential-outcome/baseline-covariate condition, not that literal sentence. No source empirical example or exercise will be reused.
sources.chapter_use: Projection framework only; Sections1 and4. The fixed-dimensional proof is supplied in the chapter, not inherited from unspecified growing-dimensional regularity.
sources.chapter_scope_limit: Population target and algebra distinct from structural causality; scoped teaching framework.

sources.authors: A. Colin Cameron and Douglas L. Miller
sources.title: A Practitioner's Guide to Cluster-Robust Inference
sources.source_date: 2015, Journal of Human Resources 50(2), 317-372 in this 56-page author-hosted PDF
sources.text_inspected: II.A printed p.320; II.C-D pp.323-325, equations (7)-(16); VI opening and VI.A pp.340-341.
sources.supports: Conditional covariance and cluster-score sandwich; averaging over independent clusters; known-covariance GLS versus estimated weighting; covariance-model-dependent efficiency; robust inference with a working covariance; few-cluster bias and critical-value limitations.
sources.limits: No universal adequate cluster count or exact general t(G-1) result follows. Current software behavior, multiway methods and bootstrap refinements were not audited.
sources.equation_check: Rendered pp.324-325 confirm that the correction c multiplies the covariance, equivalently residuals are scaled by sqrt(c); text extraction dropped the square root. FGLS residuals and both weighting factors in equation (15) were checked visually.
sources.chapter_use: Known versus working covariance and cluster-score covariance framework; Sections2,5,6. Exact efficiency, finite-group score limits and bounded-size cluster proof independently supplied.
sources.chapter_scope_limit: The manuscript does not assert an exact general t(G-1) law or a universal minimum cluster count.

sources.title: 14.382 Spring 2017 Lecture 4: Euler Equations, Nonlinear GMM, and Other Adventures
sources.text_inspected: Printed/PDF p.10, Lemma 2 and the immediately following long-run covariance and Newey-West estimator; reference [14] on p.22.
sources.supports: Long-run covariance as the sum of score autocovariances; Bartlett weights 1-lag/(L+1), common denominator n and symmetric lag terms; explicit dependence and moment assumptions for a stated CLT.
sources.limits: The mixing CLT is invoked, not proved there. The page asserts positive semidefiniteness but supplies neither its proof nor bandwidth conditions proving HAC consistency. General GMM results elsewhere in the PDF are outside this inspection and this preparation scope.
sources.chapter_use: Long-run covariance and Bartlett lag formula; Section8. The chapter supplies its own finite PSD and bounded finite-range consistency/CLT proofs.
sources.chapter_scope_limit: The source mixing theorem and broader GMM material are not inherited; the original Newey-West body was not inspected.

original_content: All examples, finite probability laws, problems, solutions, checker code and explicit proof expositions are original. No source exercises or empirical examples reproduced.

proof_boundaries.inherited: Working c01 finite-dimensional iid score CLT via scalar contrasts and explicitly invoked Cramer-Wold, integrable LLN, stochastic-order algebra and studentization; v03-c06 smooth scalar replacement proof; Volume2 matrix projections/spectral square root. C01 acceptance still pending.
proved_here: Population and sample projection identities and finite partial regression
Known-covariance GLS whitening and PSD linear-unbiased efficiency difference
Conditional Gaussian normal-coordinate independence and exact t/F distributions
Fixed-p iid fourth-moment residual HC plug-in and leverage-correction equivalence
Finite-group feasible-weight score perturbation under conditional mean zero
IID bounded-size cluster-score LLN/CLT and residual replacement with G normalization
Bounded stationary fixed-m CLT through separated blocks, skipped-set variance and smooth Gaussian replacement
Bartlett exact PSD identity from zero-extended moving sums
Bounded finite-range HAC consistency for L going to infinity and L^3/n going to zero, including residual error
not_claimed: General mixing or long-memory CLT/HAC theorem
Exact general heteroskedastic or few-cluster t coverage
Arbitrary estimated n-by-n covariance oracle equivalence
Post-selection or causal identification from covariance corrections
